title: Tommy Bahama sealife quilt
text:
Tommy Bahama sealife quilt. I purchased this quilt because the blues and grays were perfect for my masterbed room. It is cotton and washed and dried nicely. It is piped on the edges with a complimentary stripped print - one side is the sea life print - the other side is the stripped print that matches the piped edge. The sea life print is muted by the quilting - you almost can't tell what some of the print is until you really look at it. One of the reasons I like quilts is because I can wash them at home - as opposed to comforters that are nearly impossible to wash at home in a non-commercial machine. The material is soft after washing. The quilting is machined, of course - but is nice and creates a slightly poofy texture. The background is not a bright white - it would describe as a grayish/dirty white that is complimentary to the print. Over all, I like it. Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.
UPDATE:... 5/8/2021... There have been quite a few strings on too- the quilting.. I will continue to track.. but its disappointing. Thus 1 less star at this point.
